spans.text: ...Temporary command post, Berlin.
...That's concludes my report, Sir.
The information presented earlier was taken from Machlian's virtual consciousness. Do you have any more questions?
Griffin scrolls through the recorded images from Machlian's virtual consciousness and studies them carefully.
I see.
They figured that the government would be unable to stop so many small-scale explosions in so many regions.
This would be much more fail-safe compared to a single big terrorist attack.
Truly a meticulous plan.
It seems you are already aware of this information.
I only knew that the plan existed, but not the specifics of its implementation.
Still, I'd like to ask—given what you know of Machlian, how reliable is the information recovered from her?
I understand your concern.
After all, we successfully extracted Machlian and recovered information pertaining to a major Paradeus conspiracy from her without a hitch.
Everything has gone too smoothly, and success of this sort does seem strange.
Have you eliminated the possibility that those memories could have been implanted?
We've already checked carefully, and they are definitely not external data.
However, there is one thing that still baffles me.
The identity of Machlian, you mean?
I still don't know what role she plays in the plan.
Her memories were destroyed by someone. They are a jumbled mess and there's no way to tell what she's been through.
We cannot determine if she's bait or some unexpected element of the plan.
Whatever she is, she's worth looking into.
Correct. Whether this is a trap or genuine information about their plan, we will be able to learn something about the orchestrator by pursuing this lead.
I need to find the location described in this memory fragment and investigate further.
I'm going to find out if these events have already transpired but were obfuscated, or if they're still in the planning stage.
Don't worry about resources; requisition as many as you need.
But I need a more detailed report and images of all the memory fragments.
I hope we can be frank with each other in this exchange of information.
After all, we have a shared goal of averting disaster and making this world a better place.
Understood.
I'll be waiting for good news from you, then.
The transmission ends.
RO, Perosa, gather everyone.
Yes, Commander!
Understood!
Dandelion, select a team to dive into Machlian's memories with you. Pick out all the scenes of the disaster as soon as possible.
Alright, the Doll access bridge is up.
Ready to begin at any time.
